questionAudits.original: Someone must have taken my blue suitcase by mistake.
questionAudits.target: My blue suitcase ____ by mistake.
completedSentences: My blue suitcase must have been taken by mistake.
questionAudits.rationale: must have been taken把对过去拿错行李的推断改为被动，保留must的确信程度。情态动词后不能接had。

questionAudits.original: I do not know at all where I left the luggage receipt.
questionAudits.target: I have ____ where I left the luggage receipt.
completedSentences: I have no idea at all where I left the luggage receipt.
I have absolutely no idea where I left the luggage receipt.
questionAudits.rationale: have no idea或absolutely no idea均表示完全不知道，保留不知道收据所在位置的当前状态。idea前不能直接使用not代替no。

questionAudits.original: Staff will consider a claim only if it is submitted within 48 hours.
questionAudits.target: Only claims ____ will be considered by staff.
accepted: that are submitted within forty-eight hours
completedSentences: Only claims submitted within 48 hours will be considered by staff.
Only claims submitted within forty-eight hours will be considered by staff.
Only claims that are submitted within 48 hours will be considered by staff.
Only claims that are submitted within forty-eight hours will be considered by staff.
questionAudits.rationale: 过去分词短语修饰claims，保留只有48小时内提交才获考虑的必要条件；48与forty-eight两种写法均接纳。复数时长应为hours。

questionAudits.original: I wish I had not left my luggage unattended.
questionAudits.target: I regret ____ unattended.
completedSentences: I regret having left my luggage unattended.
questionAudits.rationale: regret having left表达对过去让行李无人看管的遗憾，与wish加过去完成时否定对应。having后必须用left过去分词。

questionAudits.original: The staff checked the labels and only then returned our bags.
questionAudits.target: The staff returned our bags ____.
completedSentences: The staff returned our bags only after checking the labels.
questionAudits.rationale: only after checking保留工作人员先核对标签、随后才归还行李的顺序及同一施事者。after后用动名词checking而非动词原形。

questionAudits.original: None of the people at the desk helped us.
questionAudits.target: Nobody at the desk ____.
completedSentences: Nobody at the desk gave us any help.
Nobody at the desk provided us with any help.
Nobody at the desk provided any help to us.
Nobody at the desk gave any help to us.
questionAudits.rationale: gave somebody help在这里表示实际提供帮助，Nobody保留无人帮助的否定，不把仅提出帮助当成已提供帮助。单独的given缺少所需助动词，不能作该句过去时谓语。

questionAudits.original: The robot demonstration had barely begun when the alarm was triggered.
questionAudits.target: The robot demonstration ____ when the alarm was triggered.
completedSentences: The robot demonstration had hardly begun when the alarm was triggered.
The robot demonstration had hardly started when the alarm was triggered.
questionAudits.rationale: had hardly begun或started与had barely begun均表示演示刚开始警报就响起，保留过去完成时。began不能用作had后的过去分词。

questionAudits.original: People expect the new exhibition to attract larger audiences.
questionAudits.target: The new exhibition is ____.
completedSentences: The new exhibition is expected to attract larger audiences.
questionAudits.rationale: be expected to加动词原形构成报道式被动，保留对新展览吸引更多观众的预期。attracting to不是该结构。

questionAudits.original: The display has very little practical value for school groups.
questionAudits.target: The display is ____ for school groups.
completedSentences: The display is of very little practical use for school groups.
questionAudits.rationale: be of little use表示实用价值很小，very little practical保留程度与范围。use表示用途价值时为不可数，不能用few。

questionAudits.original: We checked the safety barrier twice because we feared leaving a gap.
questionAudits.target: We checked the safety barrier twice ____ a gap.
completedSentences: We checked the safety barrier twice for fear of leaving a gap.
questionAudits.rationale: for fear of doing表示担心出现某事而采取预防行动，保留两次检查的目的。of后用leaving，to leaving不合该搭配。

questionAudits.original: The children found the optical illusion fascinating.
questionAudits.target: The children ____ optical illusion.
completedSentences: The children were fascinated by the optical illusion.
The children were fascinated with the optical illusion.
questionAudits.rationale: be fascinated by或with表达儿童对该视觉错觉着迷，与found it fascinating的感受者和对象相同。of不是此处的搭配。

questionAudits.original: The teacher had booked in advance, which was the only reason we could enter the workshop.
questionAudits.target: If the teacher ____, we could not have entered the workshop.
completedSentences: If the teacher had not booked in advance, we could not have entered the workshop.
questionAudits.rationale: 过去反事实条件If...had not booked与would或could not have entered搭配，保留提前预约是唯一进入条件。固定短语为in advance。

questionAudits.original: I have arranged for a specialist to clean my clarinet tomorrow.
questionAudits.target: I am going ____ tomorrow.
completedSentences: I am going to have my clarinet cleaned tomorrow.
questionAudits.rationale: have something done表示安排他人完成清洁，保留已安排明天由专业人员处理单簧管的计划。物品后应接被动分词cleaned。

questionAudits.original: I did not realise how fragile the reed was until I visited the workshop.
questionAudits.target: Not until I had visited the workshop ____ how fragile the reed was.
completedSentences: Not until I had visited the workshop did I realise how fragile the reed was.
Not until I had visited the workshop did I realize how fragile the reed was.
questionAudits.rationale: Not until前置时主句用did I realise倒装，保留参观后才意识到的顺序。realise和realize拼法均可；did后不能再接had realised。

questionAudits.original: I did not need to pay for the repair, and I did not pay.
questionAudits.target: I ____ for the repair.
completedSentences: I did not need to pay for the repair.
I didn't need to pay for the repair.
questionAudits.rationale: did not need to pay表示过去没有付款必要，题目明确也没有付款。need后接to pay，不能接to paid；不给出暗示实际付过款的need not have形式。

questionAudits.original: The old pad was less flexible than the new one.
questionAudits.target: The new pad was ____ the old one.
completedSentences: The new pad was more flexible than the old one.
questionAudits.rationale: 把旧垫片更不灵活改写为新垫片更灵活，比较对象与方向保持一致。more形成比较级，后面用than而非as。

questionAudits.original: The technician excluded any possibility of restoring the cracked wood.
questionAudits.target: The technician ruled ____ the cracked wood.
completedSentences: The technician ruled out any possibility of restoring the cracked wood.
questionAudits.rationale: rule out any possibility of doing表示排除修复可能，与原句excluded对应。possibility of后接动名词，不接for restore。

questionAudits.original: The repairer insisted that nobody should rush the repair.
questionAudits.target: The repairer insisted that the repair ____.
completedSentences: The repairer insisted that the repair should not be rushed.
The repairer insisted that the repair not be rushed.
questionAudits.rationale: insisted后的被动要求可用should not be rushed或省略should的not be rushed，保留不许赶工。should后不能用being。

questionAudits.original: We have not received the written agreement yet.
questionAudits.target: We have ____.
accepted: not yet received the written agreement
not received the written agreement yet
completedSentences: We have not yet received the written agreement.
We have not received the written agreement yet.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: not yet received of written agreement
questionAudits.rationale: 两种yet位置均保留尚未收到书面协议的现在完成时。receive直接接agreement，不能在此插入of并省掉限定词。

questionAudits.original: Despite being tired, the volunteers finished cataloguing the books.
questionAudits.target: The volunteers finished cataloguing the books ____ tired.
completedSentences: The volunteers finished cataloguing the books although they were tired.
questionAudits.rationale: although引出有主语和谓语的让步从句，对应despite being tired，并明确感到疲倦的是志愿者。them不能作该从句主语。

questionAudits.original: We will cancel the event if nobody volunteers.
questionAudits.target: The event will be cancelled ____.
completedSentences: The event will be cancelled unless somebody volunteers.
The event will be cancelled unless someone volunteers.
questionAudits.rationale: unless somebody volunteers与if nobody volunteers形成相同取消条件；somebody与someone同指有人。unless后的有限从句需要volunteers。

questionAudits.original: It was my responsibility to hand back the keys.
questionAudits.target: I ____ keys.
accepted: was responsible for handing back the
completedSentences: I was responsible for handing back the keys.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: was responsible to handing back the
questionAudits.rationale: be responsible for doing与it was my responsibility to do保留我应归还钥匙的责任。for后接动名词，to handing不是该搭配。

questionAudits.original: No explanation was available for why the shelf had collapsed.
questionAudits.target: There was ____ why the shelf had collapsed.
completedSentences: There was no available explanation for why the shelf had collapsed.
There was no explanation available for why the shelf had collapsed.
questionAudits.rationale: there was no available explanation for why保留当时没有可用解释的状态，不把尚无解释扩大成原因不存在。of for不能连续引出同一个解释对象。

questionAudits.original: All the posters had been put up before the librarian arrived.
questionAudits.target: By the time the librarian arrived, all the posters ____.
completedSentences: By the time the librarian arrived, all the posters had already been put up.
questionAudits.rationale: had already been put up保留在图书管理员到来之前已经完成张贴这一过去完成的被动事件。完成被动用been而不是being。

questionAudits.original: The director was not aware that the door was locked until the removal crew arrived.
questionAudits.target: The director did not ____ until the removal crew arrived.
accepted: realise that the door was locked
completedSentences: The director did not realise that the door was locked until the removal crew arrived.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: realise that the door were locked
questionAudits.rationale: did not realise对应此前并不知情，保留搬运人员到来后才意识到门已锁的时间关系。给定REALISE的拼写必须保留；单数door不能用were。

questionAudits.original: I strongly prefer using the earlier script.
questionAudits.target: I would ____ the earlier script.
completedSentences: I would much rather use the earlier script.
I would far rather use the earlier script.
questionAudits.rationale: would much rather use表示明显更愿意采用早先剧本，与strongly prefer using保持同一选择偏好。would rather后用动词原形。

questionAudits.original: We could hear only the actors who stood close to the microphone.
questionAudits.target: Only actors standing close to the microphone ____ by us.
completedSentences: Only actors standing close to the microphone could be heard by us.
questionAudits.rationale: could be heard改为被动，by us保留原句听者；只有靠近麦克风者可听见这一范围不变。could后不能接been。

questionAudits.original: It is not likely that the play will be extended.
questionAudits.target: The play is ____.
completedSentences: The play is unlikely to be extended.
questionAudits.rationale: be unlikely to be extended保留剧目不太可能延长演期的判断与被动含义。unlikely后用to不定式，不用being to extended。

questionAudits.original: The actor admitted that he had lost the only prop.
questionAudits.target: The actor admitted ____.
completedSentences: The actor admitted having lost the only prop.
questionAudits.rationale: admit having lost把先前已丢失唯一道具的事实作为被承认的内容，保留原先施事者为该演员。having后用lost而不是lose。

questionAudits.original: We had barely finished painting the set when the delivery arrived.
questionAudits.target: Hardly ____ when the delivery arrived.
accepted: had we finished painting the set
completedSentences: Hardly had we finished painting the set when the delivery arrived.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: had we finish painting the set
questionAudits.rationale: Hardly前置后使用had we finished倒装，与barely finished...when保留刚刷完布景送货就到的先后关系。had后必须用finished。

questionAudits.original: We did not need to bring cooking gear because the hostel provided it.
questionAudits.target: There was ____ because the hostel provided it.
accepted: no need to bring cooking gear
completedSentences: There was no need to bring cooking gear because the hostel provided it.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: no need to bringing cooking gear
questionAudits.rationale: there was no need to bring保留不必自带炊具这一必要性判断，不额外声称实际带了或没带。to后应接bring原形。

questionAudits.original: The worsening weather forced us to seek shelter.
questionAudits.target: The worsening weather left ____ shelter.
accepted: us no choice but to seek
completedSentences: The worsening weather left us no choice but to seek shelter.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: us no choice than to seek
questionAudits.rationale: leave somebody no choice but to do表示迫使某人只能采取该行动，保留天气恶化导致找掩蔽处的因果关系。固定连接词为but。

questionAudits.original: It is unlikely that we will reach the coast before dusk.
questionAudits.target: The ____ the coast before dusk are slim.
completedSentences: The chances of our reaching the coast before dusk are slim.
The chances of us reaching the coast before dusk are slim.
questionAudits.rationale: the chances of our或us reaching...are slim表示我们黄昏前抵达的可能性较小，保留原句预测。for our reach不能引出该到达事件。

questionAudits.original: I did not know how steep the road would be.
questionAudits.target: I ____ how steep the road would be.
completedSentences: I was not aware of how steep the road would be.
I wasn't aware of how steep the road would be.
questionAudits.rationale: not be aware of how与did not know how都表达当时不知道坡度，of引出间接疑问内容。aware to不是此处搭配。

questionAudits.original: We left the campsite early in order to arrive before dark.
questionAudits.target: We left the campsite early ____ before dark.
completedSentences: We left the campsite early so as to arrive before dark.
questionAudits.rationale: so as to arrive对应in order to arrive，保留提早离开是为天黑前抵达的目的。so as后不能直接接arriving。

questionAudits.original: The old map was of no help in finding the bridleway.
questionAudits.target: The old map ____ finding the bridleway.
completedSentences: The old map was of no use in finding the bridleway.
The old map was no use for finding the bridleway.
The old map was of no use for finding the bridleway.
The old map was no use in finding the bridleway.
questionAudits.rationale: of no use或no use后接in或for doing均可表示地图无助于找到马道，保留否定评价。主语the old map为单数，不能用were。

questionAudits.original: The interviewer could not establish what the participants actually meant.
questionAudits.target: The interviewer was ____ what the participants actually meant.
completedSentences: The interviewer was not able to establish what the participants actually meant.
The interviewer was not able to find out what the participants actually meant.
questionAudits.rationale: be not able to establish或find out与could not establish均保留未能确定参与者意思的能力或结果限制。able后接to不定式。

questionAudits.original: Although the participant was reluctant, they recorded the interview.
questionAudits.target: They recorded the interview ____ participant's reluctance.
completedSentences: They recorded the interview in spite of the participant's reluctance.
questionAudits.rationale: in spite of引出the participant's reluctance，把although从句改成名词性让步短语，保留虽不情愿仍录制的关系。固定介词为in。

questionAudits.original: He said that he had not edited any of the answers.
questionAudits.target: He ____ the answers.
completedSentences: He denied having edited any of the answers.
He denied editing any of the answers.
questionAudits.explicitRejected: denied to have edited any of
questionAudits.rationale: deny having edited或editing表达否认自己编辑过任何回答，保留原句自我否定的陈述内容。deny后不接to have edited作该补语。

questionAudits.original: We need to conduct more interviews before any conclusions can be drawn.
questionAudits.target: More interviews ____ any conclusions can be drawn.
completedSentences: More interviews are needed before any conclusions can be drawn.
More interviews need to be conducted before any conclusions can be drawn.
More interviews must be conducted before any conclusions can be drawn.
questionAudits.rationale: 被动形式保留在得出任何结论前需要进一步访谈的必要条件。主语more interviews为复数，不能用单数needs。

questionAudits.original: The interviewer was offended by the participant's refusal.
questionAudits.target: The interviewer ____ the participant's refusal.
completedSentences: The interviewer took offence at the participant's refusal.
questionAudits.rationale: take offence at与be offended by在此都表示采访者因拒绝而觉得受冒犯，不凭事实原因虚构他人归责行为。独立过去时用took，不能无助动词使用taken。

questionAudits.original: The possibility that the coding rule might bias the results had never entered her mind.
questionAudits.target: It had never ____ that the coding rule might bias the results.
completedSentences: It had never occurred to her that the coding rule might bias the results.
questionAudits.rationale: occur to somebody表示某个想法进入其脑海，never保留她此前从未想到编码规则可能带来偏差。心理想到这一含义搭配to而非for。
